mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.user_id AS userId, o.remark AS remark, o.receipt_type AS receiptType, o.receiver_name AS receiverName, o.receiver_mobile AS receiverMobile, o.receiver_state AS receiverState, o.receiver_city AS receiverCity, o.receiver_district AS receiverDistrict, o.receiver_address AS receiverAddress, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.delivery_status AS deliveryStatus, o.ziti_status AS zitiStatus, o.cancel_status AS cancelStatus, o.create_time AS createTime, i.item_name AS itemName, i.item_spec_desc AS itemSpecDesc, i.num AS num, i.item_fee AS itemFee, i.discount_fee AS discountFee, i.total_fee AS totalFee, i.price AS price, i.item_id AS itemId, i.item_bn AS itemBn, r.activity_trade_no AS activityTradeNo, r.ziti_name AS zitiName, r.ziti_contact_user AS zitiContactUser, r.ziti_contact_mobile AS zitiContactMobile, r.ziti_address AS zitiAddress, r.chief_name AS chiefName, r.extra_data AS extraData, u.username AS username, c.chief_mobile AS chiefMobile FROM orders_normal_orders_items i LEFT JOIN orders_normal_orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN community_order_rel_activity r ON o.order_id = r.order_id LEFT JOIN members_info u ON o.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN community_chief c ON r.chief_id = c.chief_id WHERE o.order_type = 'normal' AND o.order_class = 'community' AND o.act_id = #{actId} AND o.order_status <> 'CANCEL' AND o.cancel_status IN ('NO_APPLY_CANCEL', 'FAILS') AND r.activity_trade_no IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.activity_id DESC, r.activity_trade_no DESC
